'''Guppy''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is the assistant of [[Gang Leaders|Dai Dai Lo]] [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]].

==Character history==
===San Fierro===
Guppy, at an unknown time, joined the [[San Fierro Triads|Triads]], specifically the Mountain Cloud Boys sub-sect, and rose through the ranks, becoming the assistant to the gang's [[Gang Leaders|Dai Dai Lo]], Woozie. He and other Triads, help Woozie overcome his blindness, although they do allow him to win at various games and bets. He first meets protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] at Carl's [[Doherty Garage|garage]] where he identifies local [[The Pleasure Domes Club|club owner]] and pimp [[Jizzy B.]] and [[San Fierro Rifa]] leader [[T-Bone Mendez|"T-Bone" Mendez]], although unable to identify the '[[Mike Toreno|leader de mysterio]]' of the [[Loco Syndicate]].

Guppy meets Carl again when he first goes to the [[Wu Zi Mu's Betting Shop|betting shop]] owned by Woozie, initially not recognising him and then telling him of the boss' 'curse'. He continues to appear alongside Woozie when Carl [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|first meets]] the gang's [[Gang Leaders|Shuk Foo]], [[Ran Fa Li|Ran Fa "Farlie" Li]], and again when Carl acts as a decoy to allow Farlie to escape from Woozie's [[Wu Zi Mu's Apartment|apartment]]. After Farlie's escape, Guppy [[Mobile Phone|phones]] Carl to tell him of his escape.

Woozie and Guppy later meet Carl as they leave Woozie's betting shop, when Woozie receives bad news. He tells Guppy to join [[Little Lion]] in attacking a [[Da Nang Boys]] freighter. Carl volunteers to take Guppy's place, a decision that saved Guppy's life as the helicopter they use to attack the ship is shot down, killing Little Lion and wounding Carl. Guppy later helps Carl and his ally [[Cesar Vialpando]] in storming the heavily guarded [[Pier 69]], allowing Carl and Cesar to [[Pier 69 (mission)|kill]] Mendez and Carl's former childhood friend [[Ryder|Lance "Ryder" Wilson]]. Guppy then accompanies Woozie when he visits Carl's garage when Woozie suggests destroying the Syndicate's [[Yay Factory|factory]].

===Las Venturas===
Guppy then follows Woozie as he moves to [[Las Venturas]] to go over the final preparations for the opening of [[The Four Dragons Casino]]. Guppy and some Triads scare off some [[mafia|mob]] thugs attacking the casinos property, managing to capture [[Johnny Sindacco|one]]. Guppy tells Woozie, who orders Guppy to 'get rid of him' but Carl tells him to tie the mobster to the hood of a car, which Guppy does, allowing Carl to [[Fender Ketchup|extract]] information from him. He then helps Woozie [[Explosive Situation|score a hole in one]] when playing miniature golf inside the casino, moving the cup to help Woozie and then moving the cup to prevent Carl getting a hole in one. He later takes the dynamite that Carl steals from [[Hunter Quarry]].

[[File:CopWheels-GTASA.jpg|right|thumb|250px|[[Carl Johnson]], [[Zero]], [[Wu Zi Mu]], Guppy and an un-named man discussing their plans of a [[Caligula's Palace|casino]] [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's|heist]], during [[Cop Wheels]].]]
Guppy later brings two chips into Woozie's office at the casino, with Woozie guessing that one must be fake due to Guppy's tone. Carl later [[You've Had Your Chips|destroys]] a [[Sindacco Family]] plastic factory that made the fake chip, with Guppy meeting to Carl to find out for Woozie how it went. Carl then illegally takes a [[Camera|photograph]] of the plans to Caligula's Palace and takes the camera to Guppy, telling him to get the film developed. Guppy then receives a package, later identified as a security card reader, from electronics expert [[Zero]] and [[Key to Her Heart|interupts Carl and Woozie while planning their planned casino heist, inadvertantly volunteering himself for the heist]], although he is [[Dam and Blast|later shown to care more about the whereabouts of coffee and donuts than the actual plan]].

Carl, after telling two eavesdroppers to 'fuck off', gains the attention and concentration of Guppy who later assists him in stealing [[Las Venturas Police Department|police]] [[HPV-1000|motorcycles]] by driving a [[Packer|car-carrying vehicle]] along the [[Julius Thruway]] to allow Carl to [[Cop Wheels|quickly leave the motorcycles and continue stealing more police motorcycles]]. Guppy later tells Carl of the '[[Leviathan|sky cranes]] after they were described by Zero but refuses to fly them, resulting in Carl [[Up, Up and Away!|stealing the sky crane]] from a [[K.A.C.C.|military site]] and stealing an armored van on his own. Guppy goes to Carl's [[Verdant Meadows|abandoned airstrip]] to paint the armored van and tells Carl that Woozie could be anywhere after insisting on driving himself.

Guppy then takes part in the [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's|casino heist]], following Woozie and Carl throughout the casinos lower levels and in taking the money, escaping in the armored van convoy from the casino's loading bay. Later, he joins Carl and a number of Triads in [[A Home in the Hills|taking back]] rapper [[Madd Dogg|Madd Dogg's]] [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]] from a [[Los Santos Vagos]] [[Big Poppa|drug dealer]]. During this mission, Guppy can be killed by the Los Santos Vagos gangsters, although it is also possible for him to survive.
